column1: # glyphmap.tsv - hand-maintained map from a DFM art blob (Glyph.Data / Picture.Data / Icon.Data / TImageList Bitmap)
# to our own redrawn glyph under art/glyphs/<name> [D2]. dfm2c.py reads it; a blob without a row is emitted as
# "missing" and listed in tools/dfm2c_blobs.txt as dropped:no-glyphmap-row. The fonts-pack / art agent appends
# rows here; merge, never clobber. Columns are tab-separated.
# W1 desktop track (append-only): the remaining TSEQUENCEFORM / TCURRENTCUE toolbar buttons and the three
# main-window toolbars (code-built in src/desktop/lj_toolbars.c, form MAINWINDOW = the lj_ctl_desc rows there).
# W4 art track (append-only): every DFM Glyph / Picture / Icon / TImageList blob that had no row (dfm2c_blobs.txt
# no-glyphmap-row 105 -> 0), sized to the blob's cell (BMP header width / NumGlyphs x height). (TSMOKEFORM dSmoke / dSmokeTimer wait for blGlyphTop in the speed button: art smoke-46x20, stpwatch2.)
